rejected: 325-19C.requirement_p50_l7: the label cites this and no drafted rule does (a person checks whether it sets a rule): 'buildings must be erected so that yards facing public streets shall conform to the minimum front yard requirements of said residential district'
325-19C.reason: The piece applies to corner lots, but none of the listed measures says whether a lot is a corner lot or which yards face public streets. The only yard measures are front_yard, side_yard_smaller, side_yard_larger and rear_yard, and they do not identify the street-facing yards. Code therefore cannot decide the requirement from the measurements available. It also needs a new measure and architect answers: what counts as a yard facing a public street, and how the two adjoining front yards map onto the measured yards. I did not guess at either, and no template is drafted. The requirement needs a corner-lot flag and street-facing yard depth measures added before a rule can be written.
